stem_bark.text: The bark of Annona squamosa is light brown-coloured, rough with shallow longitudinal furrows.
stem_bark.text_html: The bark of Annona squamosa is light brown-coloured, rough with shallow longitudinal furrows.

seed.text: The seeds of Annona squamosa are dark brown or blackish-coloured, ovate and about 1 cm long and 0.5-0.6 cm wide. Each seed is embedded in a white pulp.
seed.text_html: The seeds of Annona squamosa are dark brown or blackish-coloured, ovate and about 1 cm long and 0.5-0.6 cm wide. Each seed is embedded in a white pulp.

fruit.text: The fruit of Annona squamosa is a round or ovate syncarp . It is about 5-10 cm in diameter with many protuberances. The aggregate fruit of Annona squamosa is green-coloured with a white, sweet and edible pulp inside.
fruit.text_html: The fruit of Annona squamosa is a round or ovate syncarp. It is about 5-10 cm in diameter with many protuberances. The aggregate fruit of Annona squamosa is green-coloured with a white, sweet and edible pulp inside.

flower.text: The flowers of Annona squamosa are axillary and solitary. The calyx is composed of 3 triangular, 2 mm long and 3 mm wide sepals. The calyx is light green-coloured. The corolla is composed of 3 cream-coloured and light-green petals. The petals are fleshy, oblong, 2-2.5 cm long and 6-7 mm wide. The androecium is composed of numerous and short stamens. The pistils are also numerous. The flowers are fragrant.
flower.text_html:
The flowers of Annona squamosa are axillary and solitary.
The calyx is composed of 3 triangular, 2 mm long and 3 mm wide sepals. The calyx is light green-coloured.
The corolla is composed of 3 cream-coloured and light-green petals. The petals are fleshy, oblong, 2-2.5 cm long and 6-7 mm wide.
The androecium is composed of numerous and short stamens.
The pistils are also numerous.
The flowers are fragrant.

leaf.text: The leaves of Annona squamosa grow alternately on the stem (spirally arranged). The leaf is simple, bright green-coloured above and paler beneath. The leaf is coriaceous and glabrous on both sides. The leaves have a 1.5 cm long petiole . The leaf of Annona squamosa is 10-20 cm long and 4-7 cm wide. The shape of the blade is elliptic or lanceolate, the apex is acute or acuminate, the base is cuneate and the margins are entire. The venation of the leaf is reticulate with a prominent midrib.

habit.text: Annona squamosa is a small-sized and deciduous fruit tree growing up to 6-8 m high.
habit.text_html: Annona squamosa is a small-sized and deciduous fruit tree growing up to 6-8 m high.

reproduction_dispersal.text: Annona squamosa is bisexual (each flower of each individual has both male and female structures). Annona squamosa is pollinated by a wide variety of insects. The seeds of Annona squamosa are mainly dispersed by frugivorous birds and mammals.
reproduction_dispersal.text_html:
• Sex distribution :

    Annona squamosa is bisexual (each flower of each individual has both male and female structures).

  • Mode of pollination :

    Annona squamosa is pollinated by a wide variety of insects.

  • Seed dispersal :

    The seeds of Annona squamosa are mainly dispersed by frugivorous birds and mammals.

others.text: The unripe fruits, seeds and leaves of Annona squamosa have effective vermicidal and insecticidal properties. The oil extracted from the seeds has been employed against agricultural pests. Sources : - Orwa C., Mutua A., Kindt R., Jamnadass R., Anthony S., 2009, Agroforestree Database: a tree reference and selection guide - Wikipedia, https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Annona_squamosa

culinary.text: Annona squamosa is a popular seasonal fruit with great economic importance in a number of tropical countries.
culinary.text_html: Annona squamosa is a popular seasonal fruit with great economic importance in a number of tropical countries.

reforestation.text: Annona squamosa is a light demander and fairly drought resistant. It will grow in a wide variety of situations and soils. The species is propagated by seeds. 24 hours of soaking in water accelerates the germination process.
reforestation.text_html:
• Planting advice and requirements :

    Annona squamosa is a light demander and fairly drought resistant. It will grow in a wide variety of situations and soils.
    The species is propagated by seeds.

  • Seed treatments :

    24 hours of soaking in water accelerates the germination process.
